data.summary:
* Split 624-line `githubAgent.ts` into a 104-line orchestrator + `dispatchAgent.ts` (449 lines, LLM setup/invocation) + `processResponse.ts` (183 lines, triage validation) under new `githubAgent/` sibling directory.
  * Public API (`evaluateEvent`, `evaluatePREvent`, `isGitHubAgentEvent` + types) preserved; no DI/services.ts/route changes; existing 68-test suite unchanged and passing.
  * `DispatchOutcome` discriminated union with `Extract<...>` narrowing lets processResponse skip runtime guards; 12 pre-existing v8-ignore pragmas carried over verbatim with zero new ones.
  * Added 41 new tests (28 dispatchAgent + 13 processResponse) covering valid dispatch, orchestrator-unavailable error-without-retry, success-response side effects, and failure-response paths.
  * Code review returned zero Critical/Important issues; addressed minor export-visibility nits in a follow-up commit.
  * CI green: `pnpm run ci:tracked` → ✅ 15,965 tests passed; PR opened at https://github.com/pbuchman/intexuraos/pull/1936.
